Hi Alex —

Great to meet today — thanks for walking us through DeepFin's ingestion pipeline and the conversational routing use case. Quick recap and the items we agreed I'd follow up on:  

- Scope: Retrieval-augmented generation for support chat + a batch reranking pipeline for search results. Expectation is low-latency responses for chat and nightly batch jobs for reranking.
- Models: production will start on open Llama variants (7B/13B) with a possible eval of an LLM-compat variant for reranking.
- Traffic & ramp: rough initial target ~100M tokens/mo in month 1, ramping to ~1B tokens/mo by month 12 (you mentioned major product launch in Q4).
- Key asks from you: confirmed monthly token volumes, target budget range, and whether DeepFin wants a committed-use quote (term + $/month) vs purely pay-as-you-go.

Pricing & discounts I said I'd share:  
- Our hosted baseline price and illustrative unit economics per 1M tokens.
- Startup program eligibility + the term sheet for committed discounts and multi-year incentives.

Attachments: Redwood-Pricing-Overview.pdf (pricing bands & example math), Startup-Program-Termsheet.pdf (startup eligibility & benefits).

Next steps: Can you confirm the expected token volume profile (month 1 / month 6 / month 12) and an approximate annual budget range you have in mind? If you qualify for the startup program, we can layer that on top of a committed-use discount and save the most on unit economics.

Happy to hop on a short follow-up with Aditya (SE) to align on perf/latency targets next week.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole

Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@deepfin.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 13:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Redwood pricing & startup discount

Alex — thanks for the numbers, that's very helpful. Below is a concise breakdown of how the programs stack and example unit economics so you can plug in your ramp profile.

Summary of discounting (illustrative):
- Baseline hosted list: $30 per 1M tokens (this is an example band for the model family we discussed).
- Startup program: 40% off list for qualifying startups for first 12 months (applies on top of baseline). Eligibility: <$10M ARR or earlier stage; we verify with standard documentation (incorporation + funding note).
- Committed-use discounts: tiered by committed $/month or committed token volume. Typical examples: 10% off for a modest 6-month commit (~$10k/mo), 20% off for a meaningful 12-month commit (~$25k+/mo), 30%+ for very large volume commitments (>$100k/mo).
- Multi-year incentive: additional 5	10% discount for 2+ year contracts (applies to committed discount portion).

How they stack (example math):
- Baseline $30/1M
- + 20% committed-use -> $24/1M
- + 10% multi-year incentive -> $21.60/1M
- OR startup 40% off baseline -> $18/1M (startup + committed can be combined in certain cases; for small startups we often cap stacking so legal/finance will confirm in formal quote).

Given your 12-month ramp to ~1B/mo, here's a sample committed quote structure we can prepare:  
- Year 1 committed spend: $300k	500k (ramped months) -> target blended $/1M = $18	3$24 after committed + startup where applicable.
- Year 2 (with higher volumes) -> with larger committed tier we can move towards $10	15/1M for extremely high sustained volume.

I'll attach a short spreadsheet that models the ramp and the blended $/1M across tiers. Also linking a sample committed-use quote template and our DocuSign template for SOWs.

Attachments: Committed-Use-Examples.xlsx
Links: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/8721/DL-4721 (deal record), https://www.docusign.com/templates/redwood-committed-use-quote

If you can confirm that DeepFin qualifies for the startup program (and send the qualifying docs), I'll get our finance team to produce a formal committed-use quote showing the stacked discounts and final unit economics. Would you like us to propose a 12-month ramped commitment (with a 12-month payment schedule) or a monthly billing with a year-of-commit true-up? We can do either.

I'm available Tue/Thu next week for a quick follow-up with Aditya to align on perf targets and finalize the committed numbers.

Best,
Marissa

[Attachment: Committed-Use-Examples.xlsx (xlsx)]
